status: Frozen before first numerical execution; no tuning from new outcomes
purpose: Validate finite-target prediction on new ultra-slow spectra and fresh noise with independent blank calibration
scope: Prespecified synthetic holdout-style validation; not external material data or independent human blind review

calibration.distribution: iid symmetric uniform with common stationary amplitude across blank, pilot and confirmation observations
calibration.use: Inference receives b_hat only, not the true amplitude; calibration event is common to both horizons and both targets

streams: SeedSequence([seed_base,truth_index,replicate,stream]), streams 0=blank,1=pilot,2=confirmation; same confirmation noise vector pairs horizons
inference: Keep the previous fixed loading, zero-floor 145-cell curvature outer envelope and 289-positive-rate inner grid; no truth-dependent grid or schedule

gate.requirement: All valid-calibration long-window targets covered and outer feasible; each truth meets >=90% unconditional observed joint coverage and >=90% valid-calibration worst-diameter utility; all valid-calibration pair brackets available; >=2 groups including >=1 continuous group have mean long outer score <=0.8 mean short inner score
gate.interpretation: A feasibility gate only. Empirical coverage is not proof of population coverage, and extra observation time is not new-method superiority.

reporting: Report calibration failures, all infeasibilities, unconditional trial-level joint coverage, valid-calibration coverage and widths, exact binomial confidence intervals; do not count correlated targets/horizons as independent replications
limitations: Only four prespecified synthetic families and one stationary uniform-noise model
Known G(0), positive spectrum, exact loading and finite upper rate support remain assumed
Calibration count adds 64 measurements to the 80 response observations; summed response-run windows are 24 versus 40, with blank acquisition cost separately unmodeled
New data are generated and checked by the same researcher/agent, not external blind review
Floating-point outer and dual checks are not outward-rounded certificates
No new algorithm or competitive-method advantage is claimed
